_comment: REOS-185: a provider usage report in the shape of a usage/cost export (one bucket per model and day, split by the batch path). costUsd is what the provider bills at the published prices (pricing-and-infrastructure section 5: Haiku 5.5 $0.10 in / $0.50 out, Sonnet 5.5 $2 / $10, Opus 5.5 $4 / $20 per million tokens; cache reads 5% of fresh input, cache writes 125%, batch half), worked out by hand, NOT by the code under test. 'calls' is the number of requests in the bucket; every call in a bucket has the same token counts, so the bucket divides evenly.
